note: Hand-drawn non-dune areas for Sweihan (WGS84). Drawn by eye on the Landsat 15 m pan images of 2000-11-27, 2013-11-07 and 2025-11-08 where human change (building, levelling, fencing, farms, road realignment) is visible but not caught by the automatic layers (NDVI, ESA WorldCover, OpenStreetMap). Used only to EXCLUDE areas from dune-motion statistics (and from stable ground). Each polygon states why.

properties.reason: NW settlement west of the E20: scattered plots in 2000, a dense block of compounds, walls and plots by 2013 that keeps growing to 2025. Built-up change, not dune motion.
properties.drawn_on: Landsat pan B8 2000-11-27, 2013-11-07 and 2025-11-08 (notebook 02 grid, 15 m, viewed at full resolution with a 0.005 deg lon/lat grid)

properties.reason: E20 (Sweihan Road) corridor in the NW: a single carriageway in 2000, realigned and dualled by 2013 (the 2000 and 2013 alignments differ by up to ~50 m), with an interchange at 24.480 N. OSM buffers only the current line.
properties.drawn_on: Landsat pan B8 2000-11-27, 2013-11-07 and 2025-11-08 (notebook 02 grid, 15 m, viewed at full resolution with a 0.005 deg lon/lat grid)

properties.reason: Levelled and fenced area north of the E16 (a diamond-shaped enclosure with a pushed-up sand pile inside, and fenced plots south-east of it): dunes in 2000 and 2013, graded by 2025.
properties.drawn_on: Landsat pan B8 2000-11-27, 2013-11-07 and 2025-11-08 (notebook 02 grid, 15 m, viewed at full resolution with a 0.005 deg lon/lat grid)

properties.reason: Elongated flat inside the northern dune belt (WNW-ESE, ~1.8 x 0.4 km): a graded strip already in 2013, excavated and brighter by 2022-2025. Non-dune surface with non-dune change.
properties.drawn_on: Landsat pan B8 2000-11-27, 2013-11-07 and 2025-11-08 (notebook 02 grid, 15 m, viewed at full resolution with a 0.005 deg lon/lat grid)

properties.reason: Housing grid west of the junction (absent in 2013, street grid by 2019-2025) on a long flat strip parallel to the E16 that was dark in 2000 and pale in 2013 (graded ground).
properties.drawn_on: Landsat pan B8 2000-11-27, 2013-11-07 and 2025-11-08 (notebook 02 grid, 15 m, viewed at full resolution with a 0.005 deg lon/lat grid)

properties.reason: Military compound north of the E16 and the fenced plots added beside it after 2013 (new buildings and walls 2013-2025).
properties.drawn_on: Landsat pan B8 2000-11-27, 2013-11-07 and 2025-11-08 (notebook 02 grid, 15 m, viewed at full resolution with a 0.005 deg lon/lat grid)

properties.reason: New fenced compound in the NE corner, absent in 2013, present in 2025.
properties.drawn_on: Landsat pan B8 2000-11-27, 2013-11-07 and 2025-11-08 (notebook 02 grid, 15 m, viewed at full resolution with a 0.005 deg lon/lat grid)

properties.reason: Farm corridor east of the town between the E16 and the southern dunes: plots added, abandoned and re-fenced between 2000 and 2025 (unvegetated plots are missed by NDVI/WorldCover).
properties.drawn_on: Landsat pan B8 2000-11-27, 2013-11-07 and 2025-11-08 (notebook 02 grid, 15 m, viewed at full resolution with a 0.005 deg lon/lat grid)

properties.reason: Abandoned farm grid in the SE: irrigated plots in 2000, faded to a grid of tracks/walls by 2013 and being covered by sand from the north-west by 2025. A sand-encroachment target for notebook 03, not a tracking area: its static grid would pull dune speeds toward zero.
properties.drawn_on: Landsat pan B8 2000-11-27, 2013-11-07 and 2025-11-08 (notebook 02 grid, 15 m, viewed at full resolution with a 0.005 deg lon/lat grid)

properties.reason: Water tanks/pond built south of the town between 2000 and 2013.

properties.reason: Compound at the southern edge of the SW dune belt that grew between 2000 and 2025, with a new fenced enclosure to its south (2025).

properties.reason: Graded bright patches, tracks, a camp and a dark structure added on the gravel flat along the toe of the SW dune belt between 2013 and 2025 (55.286-55.320 E). Found after the first runs: windows centred on this flat showed 2-8 m/yr toward the NE with low match quality (0.2-0.3), out of line with the belt (about 1 m/yr toward the east).
